source.by: tools/gen_m9_fixtures.py, with sympy 1.13.3, mpmath 1.3.0 at 50 digits, scipy 1.14.1
source.inputs: points give a, b, x, y, p_CH4, p_H2O, in that order: the context's variables a, b, x, y, then p[CH4] and p[H2O]
source.values: SymPy's reading of each text as Python syntax (^ as **), at each point, by mpmath at 50 digits, rounded to the nearest double; scales are each point's largest magnitude of any subexpression
source.gradients: SymPy's derivative of each case with respect to each input, in the inputs' order, at each point, by mpmath at 50 digits, rounded to the nearest double
source.renderings: reflux's, from tools/expr_render.v, each decoded here and found to mean the text, to 50 digits at every point
source.readings: readings and units after a group (D2, as amended before M9 step 10), in a context of T in K and P in Pa, points giving T then P: each text's meaning written out in SymPy with the units' exact values from NIST SP 811, values and derivatives with respect to T and P by mpmath at 50 digits
